analytics.name: Analytic 1848
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Ingress Tool Transfer by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Application Permission via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]; Application State via Android Enterprise / EMM [Managed package inventory/status and package metadata]; File Creation via Application Vetting / Forensic Acquisition [Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: App writes newly retrieved binary, archive, native library (.so), DEX, or script to /data/data//files/, cache, or shared storage within $IngressWriteWindow$ of network retrieval from non-CDN source]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: 30-day per-app network destination baseline. Any download from outside this list is anomalous.
Browser, MDM agent, enterprise content apps approved for remote retrieval. Derive from MDM catalog.
Default 60s between network retrieval and local file write. Tightening: 15s — synchronous download-write.
Default 120s between local file write and exec invocation. Tightening: 30s — immediate load after write.
